scope: English companion dialogue, story mentions, HUD, all actor and message vocal triggers, title, and facing. Other language slots are preserved.
runtime_acceptance: Pending user cold-boot replay of intro and normal speech; builds and static checks do not prove runtime acceptance.

lines: You want to call Saria, I think.
She knows the forest quite well.
Talk to Saria, or say no.
No Saria. That's your decision.
Maybe you want my advice instead.
Say yes or no; it's up to you.

voiced_messages.context: Navi offers to call Saria after giving advice

lines: Maybe Saria gets the next word.
Very nice; she knows the forest.
Talk to her? Choose yes or no.
We can call Saria again.
Sometimes the second call is useful.
Choose yes if you want her.
Strange. This door will not open.
A door ought to do one thing.
We need another approach.
Those bars are serious iron.
You can pull all day; no result.
Your hands cannot open them.
The chains tell you the answer.
I've dealt with many locked doors.
This one needs a Small Key.
This is not an ordinary lock.
A Small Key won't impress it.
Come back with the Boss Key.
Something covers the entrance.
The room is making us earn it.
Solve this puzzle to open the way.
That key does not fit this lock.
Good key, perhaps. Wrong door.
Find the one made for this door.
Now, what is that over there?
People miss these things. I don't.
Take a look before we move on.
There's a whole room below us.
The web hides it, but not well.
Look down with the C-Up view.
Look at that wall--rough, vines.
I've seen climbable walls before.
This is one. Go straight up.
Doors are simple, generally.
Stand close and watch the blue icon.
When it says Open, press A.
They left a ladder hanging there.
Old ladder, but it may be useful.
Find a way to bring it down.
I've seen that design before.
Same mark as the Door of Time.
That cannot be an accident.
This torch was burning recently.
You can tell. The evidence is there.
See if we can light it again.
Narrow halls invite an ambush.
They wait around corners--typical.
Hold Z and sidestep to look first.
This block can work for us.
Grab it with A; push or pull it.
Press toward it with A to climb.
There's more under the water.
There usually is; nobody checks.
Get in, hold A, and dive down.
That's a field of Bomb Flowers.
One explosion could start the rest.
Set them all off together.
A lot of lava in this room.
No railings, no plan, no surprise.
Watch every step you take.
That switch raises the platform.
It will not wait around for us.
Hit it and ride to floor two.
Another blind corner. I know them.
Something always waits back there.
Use Z and look before turning.

voiced_messages.context: Look at a point of interest

lines: What exactly are we looking at?
It caught your eye for a reason.
Check it closely before leaving.
That face is not welcoming us.
I've seen friendlier desert statues.
Inspect the Colossus carefully.
The spirits are giving a clue.
They whisper; I prefer plain talk.
Use the eye of truth here.
The spirits mention sacred feet.
A dramatic way to say the boots.
Wear Hover Boots; follow the wind.
The wall says danger is above.
Useful warning, surprisingly clear.
Keep watching the ceiling.
Now the wall says danger below.
This room covers every direction.
Watch the ground under you.
That statue floods the whole floor.
An astonishing plumbing decision.
Stop that flow to change the room.
The green slime is electrified.
Touching it would be a bad deal.
Keep away while it has power.
That red slime carries current.
It looks soft; it is not friendly.
Do not touch it while charged.
The blue slime has power too.
Different color, same awful shock.
Stay clear until it is safe.
This switch wants more weight.
You alone do not close the deal.
Put something heavy on it.
Cutting that tail removed the red.
So the tails control these things.
Cut the matching ones as well.
There's a switch behind this wall.
They hid it, but we found it.
Reach it or strike it from here.
Something is up on that platform.
High place, deliberate placement.
Get up there and inspect it.
Look at all these flags.
Most are fake--you can feel it.
Find which ones are actually real.
A voice says five Silver Rupees.
Specific number, simple assignment.
Collect all five to proceed.
The wall offers a ferry ride.
To the other world--quite a route.
Come here when you want the boat.
That boat is extremely old.
Would I certify it? I would not.
Ride carefully; it may sink.
There's our door across the gap.
Close enough to see, not to reach.
Find a way over to it.
That red ice is unusual.
Normal fire may not make the deal.
Find something special to melt it.
Blue Fire is not natural fire.
That usually means it has a use.
Capture some and try it on ice.
The torch flames are all gone.
The ghosts took them--very obvious.
Defeat each ghost; bring them back.
One torch is burning again.
You beat a ghost; the flame returns.
So that is how this room works.
They painted arrows on the floor.
Not subtle, but perhaps helpful.
See where they are pointing.
This entire corridor is twisted.
Walls, floor--a total rearrangement.
Adjust to its new direction.
The ceiling monsters cast shadows.
They think nobody looks down.
Watch the floor and dodge them.
There's a treasure chest here.
Could be useful; could be nonsense.
Open it and we will know.
We saw this torch at the entrance.
Same torch, moved or connected.
Remember it for this puzzle.
That torch is lit now.
Something we did caused it.
It marks progress in this room.
The switch is frozen solid.
A switch that cannot switch--bad.
Melt the ice around it.
The ceiling is coming down.
No warning, no standards at all.
Move now and avoid the crush.
I hear Gorons below us.
They're probably trapped down there.
Find a route to reach them.
Look down--Darunia's room.
We have seen it from below before.
Now find a way back into it.
That statue looks familiar.
We saw one before; same design.
Use what worked the first time.
That switch is badly rusted.
A gentle touch will do nothing.
Hit it with something heavy.
These vortexes pull very hard.
They swallow anything nearby.
Keep your distance and swim clear.
The Great Deku Tree summoned us.
A tree that important doesn't call
without a reason. Let's go.
We came all this way to the tree.
Some people stop at the entrance.
We're going inside. Be brave.
The Deku Tree gave us a mission.
Visit the princess at the castle.
We should get moving.
The ranch girl lost her father.
How do you lose a full-grown man?
Find him near the castle.
This castle is bigger than it looks.
Zelda is somewhere inside it.
Avoid the guards and find her.
Saria knows the forest network.
She hears things before others do.
Ask what she knows about Hyrule.
Impa gave us a solid lead.
The Fire Stone is on the mountain.
Search Death Mountain for it.
The cavern entrance is blocked.
Fortunately, bombs change a deal.
Use a Bomb Flower to get in.
Darunia mentioned a Great Fairy.
Lives at the summit, apparently.
Climb Death Mountain and visit.

voiced_messages.context: Ask Saria about the Water Stone

lines: One Spiritual Stone remains.
Saria may know who controls it.
Call her and ask about the stone.
Ruto is inside a giant fish.
That is the report, unbelievably.
Enter Jabu-Jabu and find her.
We have all three stones now.
That took work; nobody handed them
to us. Return to Hyrule Castle.
Zelda threw something in the moat.
I watched it happen--very clear.
Search the water and recover it.
We have the stones and ocarina.
That combination means something.
Check inside the Temple of Time.
Sheik says go to Kakariko.
Mysterious person, but good record.
Let's follow the lead for now.
Something changed in the forest.
And Saria has gone quiet too.
Go back and investigate both.
That cloud over Death Mountain--
it does not look like weather.
Go up there and investigate.
Cold wind comes from Zora's River.
This is not normal Hyrule weather.
Follow it toward the Domain.
Those Iron Boots weigh a ton.
Usually a problem; here, an asset.
Wear them at the bottom of the lake.
We still need the other Sages.
Somebody in Hyrule knows where.
Find a person with information.
That monster came from the well.
People ignored it until it escaped.
Go back and inspect the well.
Who built the Spirit Temple?
Nobody builds that in the desert
without a purpose. Investigate.
Sheik taught us the Nocturne.
Songs tend to open unusual routes.
Play the Nocturne of Shadow.
Ganondorf came from the desert.
That makes it worth examining.
Go there and search for a lead.
Now we have Silver Gauntlets.
Things that would not move before
are negotiable. Equip them.
Someone waits at the Temple of Time.
I have a strong idea who it is.
Go there and meet them.
Zelda is held in Ganon's Castle.
He made it grand; still a prison.
Get inside and rescue her.
We're still moving forward.
There may be no fresh lead yet.
Keep going with the current job.
We don't know this one yet.
Watch how it moves; choose a weapon.
Gohma has one eye doing everything.
When it turns red, stun and strike.
That egg becomes a bigger problem.
Break it now, before it hatches.
The larva commits to every jump.
Block the leap, then counter.
Armor in front, soft underneath.
Wait for it to turn; hit the belly.
The bigger one has the same flaw.
Wait for the belly, then strike.
The body is one electric trap.
Avoid it and attack the tail.
Deku Baba. All mouth, no results.
Dodge the lunge, then attack.
Big Deku Baba. Overgrown menace.
Avoid the bite. Cut the stem.
Withered Baba. Barely functioning.
Cut it down for a Deku Stick.
Deku Scrub. Throws nuts and hides.
Reflect one with your shield.
He opens his mouth before rolling.
Feed him a bomb, then strike.
The armor stops before the tail.
Hit there, then avoid the blast.
Baby Dodongo. Tiny demolition crew.
Back away when it starts flashing.
Lizalfos. Lots of jumping around.
Guard, then counter when it lands.
Dinolfos. Tougher, still beatable.
Block the attack, then punish it.
A burning Keese wants to get close.
Shoot it before it reaches you.
A Keese circles until it can dive.
Shoot it, or strike as it comes in.
The statue moves once disturbed.
Hit its back, then clear the blast.
Barinade. An electrical mess.
Boomerang the links and the core.
Tentacle. Disgusting obstruction.
Boomerang the narrow section.
Shabom. A bubble playing warrior.
Pop it with a projectile.
Biri carries electricity outside.
Stun it before you strike.
The large jelly splits when hit.
Stun it, split it, clear the pieces.
Stinger. Hiding under the floor.
Draw it out, then shoot it.
Most riders in the frames are fake.
Shoot the real one as he exits.
A Stalfos trusts its sword too much.
Block the swing, then counter.
Blue Bubble. Inflated reputation.
Remove the flame, hit the skull.
White Bubble. It spins, it stops.
Wait for the stop, then strike.
Its green flame always drops away.
Wait it out, then attack the skull.
It controls the wall above us.
Shoot it before you climb past.
This Skulltula leaves proof behind.
Defeat it and collect the token.
Volvagia. A tunneling dragon.
Hammer the head when it emerges.
All that fire protects a small core.
Hookshot it out, then attack.
The slug is dangerous while burning.
Put out the flame, then strike.
Red Bubble. Hot air with a skull.
Block it, then hit the bare skull.
The water only protects the core.
Hookshot it out, then strike.
He copies the attacks he expects.
Change your timing; surprise him.
Shell Blade. Weak in the center.
Strike only when it opens.
Spike. All defense, little talent.
Attack when the spikes retract.
Invisible, but the Lens exposes him.
Shoot both hands, then the eye.
A Redead wins when you face it.
Avoid the gaze; get behind it.
He expects his magic to scare us.
Reflect the orb, then rush him.
Gibdo. Wrapped up, still a mess.
Avoid the gaze. Attack the back.
The hand is bait, but also a clue.
Let it draw out the real target.
Dead Hand hides until one grabs you.
Escape, draw it out, hit the head.
The hand announces itself below.
Watch the shadow; dodge and strike.
It divides when you think it's done.
Destroy all three pieces quickly.
Koume controls fire, not ice.
Reflect Kotake's ice into her.
Kotake controls ice, not fire.
Reflect Koume's fire into her.
Iron Knuckle. Nabooru is inside.
Dodge the axe and break the armor.
Heavy armor slows the axe recovery.
Dodge, then attack the opening.
This Skull Kid attacks from range.
Answer from a safe distance.
Like Like. It steals your equipment.
Keep away and strike quickly.
Beamos. Surveillance gone wrong.
Avoid the beam and use a bomb.
Anubis copies every move you make.
Lead that copy into a flame.
Freezard. Cold, slow, unpleasant.
Avoid the breath. Fire works well.
He throws magic and expects fear.
Reflect it, use Light, then sword.
All that size, and the tail is open.
Use Light, hit tail, then the Sword.
Skull Kid. Wants entertainment.
Try music before starting trouble.
This Skull Kid could be an ally.
Play Saria's Song. Make the deal.
Skull Kid likes that mask.
Talk business and make the trade.
Octorok. Throws rocks, then hides.
Shield the rock right back at it.
The composer performs as a Poe.
Attack it and capture the soul.
Poe. Invisible when challenged.
Wait for it to appear, then strike.
Red Tektite. Constant jumping.
Block the landing, then attack.
It hops on water, but fights ashore.
Lure it there and counter.
It hides until you stop watching.
Keep moving; strike when it rises.
The blades hide vulnerable roots.
Wait for it to land; hit the roots.
The larva flies straight at you.
Block the charge, then strike.
Moblin. Big guard, narrow vision.
Dodge the charge. Hit the back.
Club Moblin. Loud club, slow turn.
Avoid shockwaves. Get behind it.
Wolfos leaves its back unprotected.
Guard, circle, strike from behind.
Mad Scrub. Angry and inaccurate.
Reflect its nuts with your shield.
Business Scrub. Tough negotiator.
Reflect one shot, then make a deal.
Dampe's ghost knows the route.
Follow closely. Do not fall behind.
Meg surrounds herself with copies.
Find the real one and use the bow.
Joelle guards one of four flames.
Strike when seen; light the torch.
Beth vanishes to avoid the fight.
Wait until seen; light the torch.
Amy. Hiding behind a block puzzle.
Solve it, then strike when visible.
Gerudo guard. Tough, not unbeatable.
Block her strike, then counter.
Stalchildren rise after dark.
A few sword strikes put one down.
One touch from it can freeze you.
Shoot it before it reaches you.
White Wolfos. Nice fur, same flaw.
Circle behind and strike the back.
The Guay must dive to threaten us.
Shoot it or strike during the dive.
Bigocto. Blocks the whole platform.
Boomerang it, then hit the rear.
Big Poe. A valuable ghost asset.
Defeat it and bottle the soul fast.
The witches alternate fire and ice.
Absorb three matching attacks.
Wasteland Poe knows the safe route.
Follow it closely through the sand.

pages: Look at this. Worth a closer look.
The Great Deku Tree sent me.
The Great Deku Tree needs you.
Up. Come on. We have a quest.
Hyrule's future is in this bed.
I'd feel better if it sat up.
Too hot. We can't stay long.
Get out before the heat gets us.
That was not part of the deal.
Your shield AND tunic are gone!
We have to recover your gear.
Take off those boots and get air.
I'm sorry. You'll have to handle
He's not keeping me out again.

short_cues.text: Look who we have here. Very interesting.

runtime_fixes.change: 183 dedicated note layers replace out-of-range signed-8-bit jumps and shared mutable note bytes.
Soundfonts 38-40 use permanent caching; audio heap grows by 64 KiB; permanent pool includes their generated sizes. WAV samples stay cartridge-backed.
Rename every quoted English Navi mention to Trump; fix companion pronouns in 0x1017 and 0x103F.
Original TRUMP lettering in the 32x8 IA4 English C-Up label; Japanese and other language slots unchanged.

Follow Navi actor shape yaw after the limb matrix reset; migrate away from camera tracking. Replace the separate face shell with one welded UV-mapped head, shaped nose/jaw, and simplified matching 32x32 calm/talking textures.
Original 96x8 OCARINA OF TRUMP subtitle in both title draw passes.

audio_policy: 177 existing full-page WAVs plus six existing short cues. The 29 additional story/warning rewrites are text; four existing embedded cue triggers are remapped. No new full-page recordings have been made.
